items.title: AMD Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: For the second quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $11.2 billion, plus or minus $300 million.

items.title: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: For the first quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $9.8 billion, plus or minus $300 million, including approximately $100 million of AMD Instinct MI308 sales to China.

items.title: AMD Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: For the fourth quarter of 2025, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $9.6 billion, plus or minus $300 million.

items.title: AMD Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: First quarter revenue was $10.3 billion ... accelerating demand for AI infrastructure ... Customer engagement around MI450 Series and Helios is strengthening, with leading customer forecasts exceeding our initial expectations.

items.title: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: For the full year 2025, AMD reported record revenue of $34.6 billion ... broad-based demand for our high-performance and AI platforms.
